last_review_summary: R92 — MAJOR RE-FRAME, supersedes the R60/R75 closer spec for what the agent's JOB is. His words: 'this is not sales skills. Please redo your work.' The agent is a SORTER, not a closer. Required behaviour: (a) prospect asks a question -> answer their most important question, then connect them to a salesperson; (b) interested -> establish a SCHEDULED TIME ('when are we going to schedule them?'); (c)…
